description: Material constants for the IR-dewar vacuum-life model (dewar_vacuum_life.{html,py}): adhesive presets, cold-shield black coatings, getter options, CH4 gas-conduction properties. Units noted per entry. Sources are cited by name only (no links) by project policy. Per REQ-D1, entries marked "assumption": true are representative values, not catalog/measured data, and are flagged as such in-app. WVR (water vapor regained, ASTM E595: 24 h at 23 C / 50 % RH after the vacuum exposure) is used as the equilibrium-water-content proxy for all organics; it is a 24 h thin-coupon rehydration and therefore a LOWER bound on long-soak bulk moisture - results are biased optimistic by up to ~2x (see repo dewar_vacuum_model/REVIEW.md c_sat range).

entries.name: aeroglaze_z306_outgassing
entries.value: TML 1.0 %, CVCM 0.02 % (ASTM E-595-77, Lord datasheet); GSFC database paint-only lots: TML 0.5-2.5 %, WVR 0.3-0.9 % (e.g. GSFC14442: 1.00/0.02/0.57, GSFC11427: 1.12/0.05/0.52, GSFC35118: 2.48/0.06/0.82). Model water content 0.6 wt% (median paint-only WVR).
entries.source: Lord Aeroglaze Z306 product datasheet DS3017 Rev.3 4/04; NASA GSFC Outgassing Database, queried 2026-08-13
entries.assumption_note: WVR-as-equilibrium-moisture proxy; lot scatter is a factor ~3

entries.name: aeroglaze_z306_film
entries.value: Dry-film density ~1.12 g/cm3 (computed: 0.95 kg/L wet, 27 wt% / 23 vol% solids -> 256.5 g solids per 230 mL dry film); max 1.1 dry mil (~28 um) per coat; theoretical coverage 9.3 m2/L at 25.4 um. Typical cold-shield build 50-75 um (2-3 coats).
entries.source: Lord Aeroglaze Z306 datasheet DS3017 Rev.3 4/04 (solids, density, per-coat limit); typical build is a project assumption
entries.assumption_note: dry-film density computed from wet datasheet values; 2-3 coat build is representative practice, not a spec

entries.name: acktar_vacuum_black
entries.value: Fully inorganic vacuum-deposited film, 3-5 um typical, density ~1.8 g/cm3. ESA/ISME09 qualification (ASTM E595): untreated TML 3.45-5.78 %, WVR 2.03-3.76 %, RML 1.41-2.02 %, CVCM 0.00-0.01 %; after 2 h 180 C vacuum bake RML 0.31 %. The porous film physisorbs water at ambient; it releases rapidly in vacuum/bake (surface-adsorbed, not diffusion-limited). Model: water 2.0 wt% of film mass, thickness 4 um.
entries.source: Miron-Salomon et al., 'Qualification of Acktar black coatings for space application', ESA ISME09 proceedings, numbers via Acktar's published qualification summary (read 2026-08-13); Acktar Vacuum Black product literature (thickness, CVCM 0.001 %)

entries.name: epotek_h70e
entries.value: TML 0.99 %, CVCM 0.03 %, WVR 0.25 % (GSFC12127; lot range WVR 0.15-0.28 across GSFC11267/GSFC35175). Mixed density ~1.88 g/cm3 (computed: SG A 1.5, B 2.5, 1:1 by weight). Model water content 0.25 wt%.
entries.source: NASA GSFC Outgassing Database entries GSFC12127/GSFC11267/GSFC35175 (queried 2026-08-13); EPO-TEK H70E Technical Data Sheet Rev VIII 10/2005 (specific gravities, mix ratio)
entries.assumption_note: WVR proxy; mixed density computed from part specific gravities

entries.name: epotek_353nd
entries.value: TML 0.76 %, CVCM 0.00 %, WVR 0.35 % (GSFC29110; WVR 0.34-0.36 across GSFC33328/GSFC31336/GSFC20704). Mixed density ~1.18 g/cm3 (computed: SG A 1.2, B 1.02, 10:1 by weight). Model water content 0.35 wt%.
entries.source: NASA GSFC Outgassing Database entries GSFC29110/GSFC33328/GSFC31336/GSFC20704 (queried 2026-08-13); EPO-TEK 353ND Technical Data Sheet (part specific gravities, mix ratio)
entries.assumption_note: WVR proxy; mixed density computed from part specific gravities

entries.name: stycast_2850ft
entries.value: TML 0.25 %, CVCM 0.01 % (Cat 9, cured 24 h 25 C, per NASA RP 1124; Henkel TDS). GSFC database WVR 0.05-0.15 % across catalysts (e.g. GSFC35499: 0.39/0.00/0.07 Cat 9; GSFC22120: 0.48/0.01/0.11 Cat 23LV). Mixed density 2.29 g/cm3 (Cat 9/11, TDS); water absorption 24 h immersion 0.03 %. Model water content 0.10 wt% - heavily silica-filled, the driest preset.
entries.source: LOCTITE STYCAST 2850FT Technical Data Sheet, Henkel, December 2024; NASA GSFC Outgassing Database (queried 2026-08-13)

entries.name: scotchweld_2216_gray
entries.value: TML 0.77 %, CVCM 0.04 %, WVR 0.23 % (NASA 1124 Rev 4, 7 d 25 C cure; matches GSFC16998/GSFC17001). GSFC gray-lot WVR range 0.21-0.51 (e.g. GSFC19045: 1.13/0.02/0.51). Mixed density ~1.3 g/cm3 (3M TDS). Model water content 0.30 wt% - the flexible 'wet' comparison preset.
entries.source: 3M Scotch-Weld Epoxy Adhesive 2216 B/A Gray Technical Data Sheet; NASA GSFC Outgassing Database (queried 2026-08-13)
entries.assumption_note: WVR proxy; using 0.30 (mid-range of gray lots) rather than the single TDS 0.23 figure

entries.name: repo_generic_epoxy
entries.value: Water 1.0 wt%, density 1.15 g/cm3, D(295 K) = 2e-9 cm2/s, Ea = 0.45 eV - the repo-calibrated conservative default (equilibrium moisture at ~50 % RH, not a 24 h WVR).
entries.source: cross-reference: research/data/outgassing_anchor_rates.json entries polymer_water_content (Chiggiato, arXiv:2006.07124) and epoxy_water_diffusivity; dewar_vacuum_model/configs/baseline_idca.yaml

entries.name: shared_water_diffusivity
entries.value: All organic reservoirs (adhesive presets AND Z306 polyurethane film) share D(295 K) = 2e-9 cm2/s, Ea = 0.45 eV. Formulation spread is a factor 4 either way (5e-10..8e-9) and is the #2 uncertainty driver after venting geometry. Thin coatings (<100 um) fully deplete during any competent bake regardless of D, so post-bake coating results are D-insensitive; thick adhesive reservoirs are NOT.
entries.source: research/data/outgassing_anchor_rates.json entry epoxy_water_diffusivity (Microelectron. Reliab. 2019 S0026271419311771; IEEE ECTC 2008 4525009); polyurethane-specific diffusivity data are thin - shared-D is a project assumption; sensitivity ranking per dewar_vacuum_model/REVIEW.md
entries.assumption_note: shared-D across chemistries, incl. polyurethane paint

entries.name: st707_getter_options
entries.value: Dropdown options 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 2 g of St707-class Zr-V-Fe alloy (representative sizes for an IDCA getter pill/strip - not catalog part numbers). Capacities per gram: H2 ~170 Torr.L/g bulk sorption to embrittlement limit; H2O ~2.4 Torr.L/g surface-limited estimate. Activation ~400 C x 45 min under vacuum; equilibrium floor while healthy ~1e-7 Torr (representative).
entries.source: capacities cross-reference research/data/outgassing_anchor_rates.json entry getter_capacities_St707 (Sandia National Labs St707 data report 105402; UChicago PSEC H2O note); gram sizes and p_floor are project assumptions
entries.assumption_note: gram options and 1e-7 Torr floor are representative; H2O capacity is a surface-limited estimate, geometry/activation dependent

entries.name: ch4_gas_conduction
entries.value: gamma = 1.31, M = 16.043e-3 kg/mol (CRC standard data); alpha_eff = 0.9 (representative, heavy molecule accommodates like air); k_cont ~0.021 W/m/K near the log-mean gap temperature (~190 K, consistent with the air/H2 values in dewar_vacuum_model/gas.py). Continuum plateau is irrelevant below ~0.1 Torr at a 5 mm gap; Lambda0(CH4, 295 K) = 1.97 W m-2 K-1 Pa-1 (computed).
entries.source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (gamma, M, k(T) for methane); alpha and evaluation temperature are representative per the repo gas.py convention (Corruccini, Vacuum 7-8, 19 (1959) for the accommodation framework)
entries.assumption_note: alpha_eff and k evaluation temperature are representative

entries.name: ice_on_filter_conversion
entries.value: Cryopumped-water thickness on the coldest optic: ice density 0.93 g/cm3; representative cold filter area 2 cm2 collecting the condensable inventory; thresholds 0.1 um measurable transmission loss, ~1 um severe in the 3.0-3.1 um band.
entries.source: thresholds cross-reference research/data/outgassing_anchor_rates.json entry ice_optics_budget (AFRL/DTIC ADA443824); 2 cm2 collection area and all-inventory-to-filter worst case are project assumptions
entries.assumption_note: worst-case: entire water inventory condenses on the 2 cm2 filter

entries.name: cooler_thermal_baseline
entries.value: Cooler net lift 0.6 W at 80 K / 3.0 W at 300 K (linear between anchors, rotary/linear Stirling tactical class); cold-space effective mass 15 g Cu-equivalent; eps_eff 0.03 shell-shield; leads+support G 0.7e-3 W/K; shell 293 K, FPA setpoint 80 K, gap 5 mm.
entries.source: cross-reference dewar_vacuum_model/configs/baseline_idca.yaml (representative class values, flagged there); Debye theta_D(Cu) = 343 K from Kittel, Introduction to Solid State Physics
entries.assumption_note: representative tactical-cooler class values, not a specific catalog cooler
